Because instead of being kind and checking to make sure the cat was okay after he stepped on one of the most sensitive parts of its body, he was annoyed and walked away. The cats think he was malicious in what he did, and I don’t blame them. Something also tells me this isn’t the first time he’s hurt those cats.
The dog didn’t know the backstory. He’s just doing his job proficiently.
The mom immediately saying “did you attack him” is all I needed to hear. Kid deserved a lesson, cat delivered.

Fun fact, cats and dogs actually understand when you apologise and pet them. As kittens and puppies, they will often push the bounderies playing too rough with their littermates, the littermate will let out a high pitched noise and the one playing rough will stop and show affection.
